column3: The exception journal source is now produced (W5a P-exception, ExceptionStore.record): one event per captured exception with BootUI ExceptionPayload fields (groupId, exceptionClass, signature, types, logged); the kind itself is not implemented; deviations: envelope executionId and threadKind absent; signature hashes the class and the first application (else innermost) frame, not BootUI's top frames; marks not carried; requestId only for this install's requests; types walk the exception's own chain (root plus 8 causes, ExceptionStore.MAX_CAUSE_DEPTH) and, for an exception group, only the first leaf's chain (BootUI has no groups), while the panel's causes list stays at 5 (pre-existing, pinned by test_causes_cycle_safe_max_five); failedOrSlow is true as in BootUI
The exception journal source (exceptionClass, requestId) is now produced; the kind itself is not implemented
